componentes.descripcion:
Presentational full-screen loading overlay. It is fully controlled: the
consumer decides when it is `visible` and which `message` it shows, so the
same component can express every loading state (boot, sign-in, sign-out,…).
It keeps no state and performs no side effects — the fade in/out is CSS only.

props.descripcion: Whether the overlay is shown. When false it fades out and stops capturing pointer events.
Extra class applied to the root overlay element.
Primary line describing what is happening (e.g. "Estamos cargando la aplicación").
Accessible label for the spinner (screen readers). Defaults to the message or "Cargando".
Optional emphasized heading rendered above the message.
Tone for the spinner accent.

componentes.descripcion:
Contained, non-blocking loading indicator. Unlike `OverlayLoader` it flows
inside its parent (no fixed positioning), so it can fill just a content
region — e.g. the microfrontend slot while its bundle mounts — without
covering the rest of the shell (the sidebar stays interactive).

props.descripcion: Extra class applied to the root element.

Stretch to fill the available width and height of the parent and center
its content, instead of rendering as a compact inline card. Use it when the
loader owns a whole region (e.g. a route's content slot).
Optional line describing what is loading (e.g. "Cargando módulo…").
Accessible label for the spinner. Defaults to the message or "Cargando".
Tone for the spinner accent.
